t: About us – American Athletic
s: Once manufacturing needs were met the American Athletic factory could produce thousands of pairs of athletic shoes and ice skates. However, to keep up with supply we needed to think big and sell to large retail shops in addition to the typical mom and pop stores. Due to our large-scale manufacturing factory we were able to offer extensive product offerings, which gave retail buyers options to buy their entire footwear inventory needs from one source.
